about_the_game:
Headphones are strongly recommended!

They can't see you if you can't see them

You have to find your way out of a fully decorated and furnished haunted mansion, navigating only by sound and the slight glimpses you get through your blindfold. Not all doors are open, so you'll have to find the keys to unlock them.

Listen to your footsteps

The sounds of your footsteps are a crucial indicator in telling you if you are moving forward or against a wall. They also provide you information about the surface you are moving on and help you identify different areas in the mansion.

Orientate yourself by listening to anomalies

There are several noises coming from fixed locations, so you can use them to figure out the direction you want to move towards.

Don't get stuck on furniture

Since the mansion is in a very orderly state with chairs, tables, cupboards, and other furniture not placed in the middle of the room, there are no corners or crevices you can get stuck in. Still, try not to mistake a small table for a wall or a corner for a dead end.

Remember what this mansion looks like

At certain locations you can remember what a room looks like. This can greatly help you in getting a sense for the layout of the room you are in.

Take off the blindfold once you are out

Once you have found your way out of this mansion, you can take off the blindfold and take a look at what you just went through. You can see if the layout of the mansion is actually the same as you imagined it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: 2.5Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones are strongly recommended!
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Listen to your footsteps, ambiance, and anomalies around you, and navigate through a giant haunted mansion to find the exit. Find keys to unlock closed doors, try not to get lost, and most importantly, don't take off the blindfold!
supported_languages: English, German, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
